kurz: On a very hot pan, a drop of water floats and dances instead of evaporating.
bild_im_kopf: Like a hovercraft: the drop floats on its own steam.
beobachtung: At first the drops hiss and evaporate quickly. Above a certain heat they form little balls that glide around and last longer.
erklaerung: A layer of steam forms under the drop and it floats on it (the [[leidenfrost|Leidenfrost effect]]). That is exactly when the pan is hot enough for searing.
sicherheit: Hot pan: only with adults; do not overheat a non-stick pan while empty.
schritte: Heat the empty pan over medium heat and now and then flick in a few drops of water.
Watch how the drops behave as the pan gets hotter.
